title: Communicating with Collection Agencies by Using Enterprise
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:16 AM

Communicating with Collection Agencies by Using Enterprise
Services or APIs

Use

You can communicate with your collection agencies by using files (creation of submission and information files, import of
collection agency files) or by using Enterprise Services or APIs. SAP provides the necessary APIs and Enterprise Services, and a
service-oriented interface. If you activate the service-oriented interface, it replaces the file interface and offers the following
additional functions:

e Groupings of collection items for submission, along with external grouping information (external collection cases or court
cases), are supported by the application in the form of collection units.

e External status information on the progress of processing is integrated in the submitting company's own status information
by using the collection history (SAP Easy Access screen: |sAccount Further Information » Collection History

(transaction FPCOLLHIST).

e Payments reported by the collection agency result in the posting of receivables which are credited to the collection agency.
This means that the system posts these receivables to the contract account of the collection agency in FI-CA.

Activities

1. To be able to use the service-oriented interface for submissions to collections, you have to activate it in Customizing for
Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable. To do this, in Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable,
choose either |#Integration » Enterprise Services > Make Central Settings for Enterprise Services J or |}Business
Transactions » Submit to Collections Activation of Communication Through API or Enterprise Service

i Note

For more information about the dependencies related to activating the service-oriented interface, see the

documentation for the indicator you use to activate the service-oriented interface.

“4S Caution

If you previously communicated with collection agencies by file, do not activate communication via Enterprise
Service/API until you have processed all the information that you received by file and stored in the system.

After you have activated communication by using Enterprise Services or APIs, you can no longer process information
that you have received by file and stored in the system.

When communicating with collection agencies by using files, the system saves the exchanged information in a different
table than when communicating with collection agencies by using the available Enterprise Services/APIs. If you switch
to communication by using Enterprise Services/APls, you must migrate the data. To do this, in the SAP Easy Access

screen, choose |sAdministration » Migrate Collection Items for Service Communication 9 (transaction FPO3MIG).

2. Then you make the necessary settings for collection agency postings in Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and
Payable in the activities Define Specifications for Processing Collection Agency Information and Define Specifications
for Collection Agency Postings under |sBusiness Transactions } Submit to Collection Agency
